# ICPay — Complete Agent Context

> ICPay is an open, on-chain financial and cloud infrastructure application running on the Internet Computer (ICP).

## Overview

ICPay is a decentralized platform integrating multi-token custody, cloud bucket storage, DEX trading, and token management into a single interface authenticated via Internet Identity.

### Key Architecture Components
- **Custody & Wallets**: User funds sit in per-principal subaccounts of the backend canister (`6vbhm-nqaaa-aaaan-q6muq-cai`). Only the owning principal can initiate transfers or withdrawals.
- **ICPay Bucket (Cloud Storage)**: Decentralized, encrypted-at-rest storage leveraging ICP storage canisters (`fly6t-piaaa-aaaan-q6oga-cai`) with high-speed global CDN delivery. Storage tiers are available in 1 GB, 2 GB, and 3 GB allotments with 30-day renewable prepaid cycle pricing.
- **Trade & DEX**: Sub-second decentralized token swaps and limit orders via `icpay_trade` (`gomfy-saaaa-aaaan-q6onq-cai`) routing to ICPSwap liquidity pools.
- **Token Launchpad**: Simple deployment of ICRC-1 and ICRC-2 compliant ledger canisters directly from the web interface.
- **On-Chain Canister Management**: Real-time cycle balances, canister top-ups via Cycles Ledger, snapshots, and controller settings.

## Site Map & Navigation

- `https://icpay.app/` — Dashboard & asset overview
- `https://icpay.app/wallet` — Wallet balances, addresses, and history
- `https://icpay.app/bucket` — ICPay Cloud Bucket dashboard
- `https://icpay.app/bucket/pricing` — Storage pricing tiers (1 GB, 2 GB, 3 GB)
- `https://icpay.app/bucket/docs` — API & SDK documentation for developers
- `https://icpay.app/trade` — DEX Swap & trading interface
- `https://icpay.app/token/create` — ICRC token creation portal
- `https://icpay.app/canister` — ICP canister management suite
- `https://icpay.app/channels` — Community messaging & discussions
- `https://icpay.app/topup` — Cycles top-up and conversion
- `https://icpay.app/transparency` — Canister IDs, controllers, and verification
- `https://icpay.app/faq` — Frequently Asked Questions
- `https://icpay.app/terms` — Terms of Service
- `https://icpay.app/privacy` — Privacy Policy
